text.en:
The municipality of Taft, in the Province of Capiz, organized under Act Numbered Seven
hundred and twenty by the consolidation of the pueblos of Makato and Tangalan, shall hereafter be known as
the municipality of Makato.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
